subject.why: The golden key is instantly recognizable, complete with shaft, bit, and ornate swirly bow featuring the requested heart cutout.

category.why: The key floats at a dynamic tilt with no surface underneath, set against a saturated gradient background with concentric rings.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The key is centered with generous, even margins on all sides and no parts cut off.

colour.why: The warm golden yellow contrasts vividly against the rich, saturated purple background.

detail.why: The forms are bold and stylized with no micro-textures, scratches, or extraneous props.

style.why: Rendered with smooth, chunky 3D volumes, a soft satin sheen, and no outlines, perfectly matching the reference cards.
